title: Fuse Hackathon - Autonomous AI Learning System
shortDescription: A self-improving, autonomous educational AI platform powered by Reinforcement Learning (PPO), Meta-Learning, and dynamic Curriculum Generation.
description: An autonomous educational AI platform that utilizes a decoupled MLOps pipeline. It features a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent to continuously optimize teaching strategies based on student feedback, autonomous curriculum generation, multi-layer hallucination detection, and a meta-learning engine to discover effective education principles.
myContributions: Implemented a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Agent with an Actor-Critic neural network architecture for continuous learning.
Developed an Autonomous Curriculum Generator to build structured, personalized learning paths from single prompts.
Built a Multi-Layer Hallucination Detection system to ensure factual accuracy via semantic consistency checks.
Created a Meta-Learning Engine to analyze cross-session patterns and update global teaching policies.
Engineered a high-performance FastAPI backend capable of sub-2-second response generation and integrated a real-time analytics React dashboard.
architectureDiagram:
graph TD
    Client[React Frontend]
    
    subgraph FastAPI Backend
        API[API Router]
        DB[(MongoDB Atlas)]
        
        subgraph MLOps Pipeline
            CG[Curriculum Generator]
            PPO[PPO Agent Actor/Critic]
            HD[Hallucination Detection]
            FB[Feedback Collection]
            RC[Reward Calculation]
            ML[Meta-Learning Engine]
        end
    end

    Client -->|1. Initial Prompt| API
    API -->|2. Store History| DB
    API -->|3. Trigger| CG
    
    CG -->|Generates Path| PPO
    PPO -->|Selects Teaching Strategy| HD
    HD -->|Verifies Content| API
    API -->|Delivers Content| Client
    
    Client -->|User Interaction/Questions| FB
    FB -->|Metrics| RC
    RC -->|Reward Signal| PPO
    
    FB -->|Cross-Session Patterns| ML
    ML -->|Updates Global Policy| PPO
features: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO): Utilizes an Actor-Critic neural network architecture to continuously optimize teaching strategies based on student feedback.
Autonomous Curriculum Generation: Instantly builds structured, personalized learning paths from a single initial prompt.
Multi-Layer Hallucination Detection: Ensures 98%+ factual accuracy via semantic consistency checks and confidence scoring.
Meta-Learning Engine: Analyzes cross-session patterns to discover and implement fundamental principles of effective education.
Real-Time Analytics Dashboard: React-based interface to monitor success rates, iterations, AI rewards, and hallucination metrics in real-time.
High-Performance API: Python FastAPI backend capable of handling sub-2-second response generations.
challenges: Implementing a decoupled MLOps pipeline separating user-facing application from the reinforcement learning loop and model state management.
Balancing the PPO Agent's Reward Calculation Engine to accurately weight student progression, engagement, and penalties for confusion or hallucinations.
Ensuring sub-2-second response generations while running complex multi-layer hallucination detection and meta-learning models.
learnings: Gained practical experience integrating Reinforcement Learning (PPO) with web application backends via FastAPI.
Mastered designing MLOps pipelines and decoupling AI model loops from user-facing systems.
Learned advanced techniques for real-time hallucination detection and prompt verification.
metrics: Achieved 98%+ factual accuracy using semantic consistency checks and confidence scoring.
Optimized Python FastAPI backend to handle sub-2-second response generations.
futureRoadmap: Deploy the complete pipeline to a scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
Expand the Curriculum Generator to support complex, multi-disciplinary subjects.
Integrate advanced multimodal learning models to support video and interactive code teaching strategies.
